title: Curves — per tag × drop fraction × slice: filter bookkeeping and outcome rates (Wilson 95 % CI)
note: Primary slice `eval_trained_conflict__heldout`; role ∈ primary / secondary / agreement. `present` = a usable scores.json backs the row (own or borrowed), `slice_present` = the slice was in it, `borrowed` / `borrowed_from` = a random tag's point taken from its sibling ΔL tag (drop000 always; drop100 when the random tag has no own parent eval). Random tags carry the control's filter bookkeeping. k = round(rate·n).
